products.name: Voicemod
products.note: Real-time voice changing; gaming/streaming; content moderation; EU vendor

profile_text.body:
Voicemod is a Spain-based software company that offers a real-time AI voice changer and soundboard for PC and Mac. The company describes itself as the leading product in its category, targeting users in gaming, streaming, and social settings. Its software provides more than 200 voice effects and runs AI voice workloads on-device, including support for the Snapdragon X Elite platform where processing is handled by the NPU for what the company describes as ultra-low latency and high-fidelity effects.

The core product, also called Voicemod, is categorized under voice and audio and is noted as an EU vendor with applications in gaming, streaming, and content moderation. No litigation, patent filings, MCP registry presence, or SEC disclosures are recorded in the held facts.
